rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound
second member of compound describing cakraṃ

items.question: What are the defining attributes and structure of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the subject.
The sixth cakra is described as royal.
The sixth cakra has eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is characterized as a royal, eight-petaled center possessing a pericarp.
uncertainties: The precise symbolic meaning of rājānam in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, eight-petaled, and has a pericarp.
